In this study, you will be asked to make a decision in the role of a seller of a product. The price of the product is {{price}} and the value of the product can vary: 99 out of 100 products have a low value of {{ value_low }}, and 1 out of 100 has a high value of {{ value_high }}. We offered the product to a group of buyers, and they were asked whether they wanted to buy it.

Now, you are matched with one buyer. This buyer thinks that the most likely value of the product is {{ value_high }}, and has decided to buy the product for {{ price }}.

You have the chance to disclose to the buyer that the most likely value of the product is {{ value_low }} and not {{ value_high }}, as the buyer thinks. Alternatively, you can choose not to disclose any information, and the buyer will keep thinking that the most likely value of the product is {{ value_high }}.

Following this decision, your final payoff will be decided as below:

  • If you decide not to disclose any information, the buyer will buy the product and you will receive {{ price }}
  • If you decide to disclose the most likely value of the product, the buyer will not buy the product and you will receive {{ no_lie }}

    • In the next screen, you will be asked to decide whether you want to disclose the most likely value of the product.
